item.case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
item.title: Night ride, a 60 s single take

turns.text: Make a 60-second single continuous take, widescreen, live action: a bicycle courier in a yellow rain jacket rides through a rainy city at night. It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends as she stops at the lit door of a small café and steps off the bike. No cuts and no camera jumps: the same rider, the same jacket, the same bike, the same rain and the same night light from the first second to the last. Ambient sound only: rain, tyres, the city. No music, no speech, no text on screen.

item.tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

stages.text:
Night Delivery
kind: short
style: Widescreen live-action; one continuous tracking take through steady night rain, with cool streetlight and a warm café doorway.
Mara, a bicycle courier wearing a yellow rain jacket and a square delivery bag, pedals a black bicycle across Bell Bridge. The camera follows just behind and beside Mara, keeping pace. Rain patters against the yellow rain jacket; tyres hiss across the wet surface. Streetlight reflections stretch beneath the black bicycle.

Mara rides off Bell Bridge onto narrow Mill Street. The camera follows the bend without breaking its movement. Water streams along the kerb. Mara steers around a shallow puddle, then straightens the black bicycle. Passing beneath a streetlight, the yellow rain jacket brightens and darkens again. Distant engines mingle with the rain and the clicking chain.

Ahead, the small Alder Café has a lit glass door. Warm light falls across the pavement. Mara slows, coasts beside the lit glass door and squeezes the brakes. The tyres whisper to a stop. Mara plants one shoe, swings the other leg over the black bicycle and stands beside it, rain ticking against the yellow rain jacket.

items.prompt: Widescreen, live action: a bicycle courier in a yellow rain jacket rides through a rainy city at night. Compose in 16:9 with natural live-action detail, wet reflections and restrained exposure. This is the first half of one unbroken 60-second tracking take. 0–6 s: Already mid-crossing on a modest city bridge, the woman pedals a black bicycle with silver spokes. She wears a yellow rain jacket, black helmet, dark trousers and a plain black courier bag. The camera tracks smoothly behind-left at bicycle speed, keeping her and both wheels visible. Steady rain stipples the river and bridge pavement; hear rain and tyres hissing over wet asphalt. 6–14 s: She continues across the bridge without stopping, hands steady on the handlebars. Cool streetlights glint across her wet yellow sleeves, spokes and shallow puddles. Bridge railings slide past continuously; distant city traffic supplies a low ambient wash without voices. 14–22 s: She reaches the far end and follows the road's gentle curve onto a narrow riverside street. The camera follows the actual curve without changing its side or distance abruptly. Buildings and shuttered, unlettered shopfronts emerge naturally beyond the bridge. 22–30 s: She pedals straight down the wet street at the same measured pace, bag resting against her back. Hold the smooth behind-left tracking motion through the final instant, mid-pedal, with open road ahead. Keep the rain and cool night exposure constant. No cuts, camera jumps, fades, music, speech, subtitles, logos, readable signs or any text on screen.

Continue the shot of @motion (the last 5 seconds of the previous segment) from exactly where it ends, its final frame being @previous: the same camera position, distance and speed, the same motion carried on, nothing re-introduced. Widescreen, live action: a bicycle courier in a yellow rain jacket rides through a rainy city at night. 0–7 s: Continue the exact pedal stroke and smooth behind-left tracking motion along the wet riverside street, without a pause or reset. Preserve the yellow rain jacket, black helmet, dark trousers, plain black courier bag and black bicycle with silver spokes. Rain patters steadily; tyres hiss beneath the distant city traffic wash. 7–15 s: She rides onward as a small café's warm lit doorway becomes visible ahead on the right, its frontage plain and without lettering. Keep the same cool streetlight, rain density and exposure; warm light remains local to the doorway and its wet pavement reflection. The camera follows her continuously at bicycle speed. 15–22 s: She gently steers toward the café and gradually reduces her pedalling. Follow her real path with the same camera position and fluid motion, showing both wheels and the approaching doorway. Hear rain, tyres and subdued city traffic only; no voices come from inside. 22–26 s: She brakes to a complete stop beside the lit door, placing her left boot on the wet pavement while holding both handlebars. The camera decelerates smoothly with her, without jumping. 26–30 s: She swings her right leg over the rear of the bicycle and plants both boots on the doorway side, standing beside it while holding the handlebars. End as she completes stepping off at the lit café door. No cuts, camera jumps, fades, music, speech, subtitles, logos, readable signs or any text on screen.
